text: `Svc::ComQueue` shall queue `Fw::Buffer` and `Fw::ComBuffer` received on incoming ports.
rationale: The purpose of the queue is to store messages.

text: `Svc::ComQueue` shall output exactly one `Fw::Buffer` (wrapping the queued data units) on a received `Fw::Success::SUCCESS` signal. `Fw::Success::SUCCESS` is valid at start-up (to initiate flow), in response to a sent message, or after a previous `Fw::Success::FAILURE` (to indicate recovery).
`Svc::ComQueue` shall pause sending on `Fw::Success::FAILURE` and resume on the next `Fw::Success::SUCCESS` signal.
rationale: `Svc::ComQueue` should not send to a failing communication adapter.

text: `Svc::ComQueue` shall have a configurable number of `Fw::Com` and `Fw::Buffer` input ports.
rationale: `Svc::ComQueue` should be adaptable for a number of projects.

text: `Svc::ComQueue` shall select and send the next priority `Fw::Buffer` and `Fw::ComBuffer` message in response to `Fw::Success::SUCCESS`.
`Svc::ComQueue` shall periodically telemeter the number of queued messages per-port in response to a `run` port invocation.
`Svc::ComQueue` shall emit a queue overflow event for a given port when the configured depth is exceeded. Messages shall be discarded.
`Svc::ComQueue` shall implement a round robin approach to balance between ports of the same priority.
rationale: Allows projects to balance between a set of queues of similar priority.

text: `Svc::ComQueue` shall keep track and throttle queue overflow events per port.
rationale: Prevents a flood of queue overflow events.

text: `Svc::ComQueue` shall return ownership of incoming buffers once they have been enqueued.
`Svc::ComQueue` shall provide a command to flush queued items.
`Svc::ComQueue` shall accept a configured depth of 0 for a port, allocating no storage for that queue and treating any message received on that port as an overflow.
rationale: Deployments may leave a port unused (e.g. no file downlink) without allocating memory or crashing.

text: `Svc::ComQueue` shall report cumulative, per-port message drops caused by async ingress and managed queue overflow separately, including both overflow policies and disabled queues.
rationale: Provide observability without generating additional messages during ingress saturation.

text: Provide a **CCSDS framer** to convert COM buffers into CCSDS frames for downlink.
Provide a **CCSDS deframing path** to parse incoming CCSDS frames into COM buffers for uplink.
Provide an F´ **router** to route deframed packets (e.g., commands/files) into the flight software.
Provide a **subtopology variant that supplies `Svc::ComStub`** designed to connect to a ByteStream driver.
Provide a **subtopology variant that expects an external `Svc::ComInterface`** supplied by the deployment.
Support **configurable instance properties** (IDs, queue sizes, stack sizes, priorities, CPU affinities, aggregation size, packet spanning) via `ComCcsdsConfig`.
Provide **composable layer topologies**: a Space Packet packet layer (`SpacePacketFraming`, `SpacePacket`) and a TM/TC transfer frame layer (`TmTcFraming`), from which the full stack is composed.
